input.enso_window_months: number - how many recent months to store (default 18)
input.enso_threshold_c: number - advisory threshold in degC (default 0.5, CPC published value)

input.countries: array of ISO3 codes to keep (default ['KE','SO','SS']); 'all' for every country
input.geometry: boolean - fetch per-country GeoJSON and store per-area bounding boxes (default true)

source: IPC via the Humanitarian Data Exchange

input.gho_indicators: array of indicator codes to restrict to (default the outbreak set)

license: WHO data: use with attribution, per WHO data terms

description: User-supplied service assets (CSV or GeoJSON)
ACLED-compatible user CSV upload
User conflict event CSV upload

DHIS2 dataValueSets pull. Maps configured data elements to climate observations and, when a mapping names BOTH enrolled_from and present_from data element UIDs, to normalized daily school attendance records (absent derived as enrolled minus present, the register arithmetic, stated per record). A single aggregate headcount is refused with an error — no invented present counts. Runs only when LINDELA_LITE_DHIS2_ENABLED=on and request.base_url is set.

input.username: string — basic auth user (used when api_token absent)
input.org_units: array of string — org unit UIDs
input.data_elements: array of string — data element UIDs to pull
input.period: string — DHIS2 period e.g. 2026Q3 (default current quarter)
input.mappings: object keyed by data element UID: { kind: climate|school_attendance, indicator?, unit?, district?, school_id?, school_name?, enrolled_from?, present_from? }

description: GDACS historical flood events (1985 onward, Sub-Saharan Africa) from the archive search API, walked quarter by quarter. Keyless. Backfill for flood-probability training; the eventtype filter is ignored upstream and runs in-process, flood severity upstream is a fill-in zero and is stored as null.

input.countries: array of ISO3 codes (default Sub-Saharan Africa); 'all' for every country

source: GDACS archive, Joint Research Centre of the European Commission

description: ERA5 reanalysis daily precipitation per pilot district, 1981 onward, via the keyless Open-Meteo archive. One record per region with the whole daily array; nulls preserved. Backfill for flood-probability training; explicitly reanalysis, not gauge observations.

input.regions: array of {name, country, lat, lon} (default the pilot regions)

description: GloFAS v4 modelled daily river discharge per pilot district via the keyless Open-Meteo flood API (1984 onward where a reach exists; consolidated reanalysis to July 2022, continued by the operational run). One record per region with a river reach; a cell without a reach is refused as an explicit error, never stored as zeros. Backfill for the discharge-labelled flood-probability variant.

input.regions: array of {name, country, lat, lon} (default the pilot regions)

description: Open-Meteo current conditions and 7-day daily forecast (precipitation, precipitation probability, temperature max, WMO weather code) for the five pilot district centroids. Keyless. Deterministic point forecast — no ensemble members, no percentiles. Writes weather_forecasts, not climate_observations, so the flood-risk scorer never sums the same atmosphere twice. Feeds the map weather overlay via GET /api/v1/weather.

input.regions: array of {slug, name, country, lat, lon} (default the five pilot districts)

description: ReliefWeb epidemic disaster events for the pilot countries (cholera, measles, meningitis, yellow fever, plague; GLIDE EP- prefix). Keyless RSS of the 20 latest disasters worldwide by default; the v2 Disaster API (subnational coordinates where published) unlocks with a ReliefWeb-approved appname via LINDELA_LITE_RELIEFWEB_APPNAME, with automatic RSS fallback while registration pends. Subnational coordinates where provided, otherwise country centroid labelled granularity:'national'; case/death counts heuristic from glance text.

input.reliefweb_appname: string — ReliefWeb-approved appname (default env LINDELA_LITE_RELIEFWEB_APPNAME); when set, the v2 Disasters API is used and falls back to RSS on 403

license: ReliefWeb content per ReliefWeb reuse terms, attribution required; GLIDE licence for ids

description: KoboToolbox submission pull. Every submission becomes a field_report carrying the raw form answers (source kobotoolbox, reporter_urn_hash null — no hashable URN arrives). A field_mapping school_attendance entry additionally yields normalized daily school attendance when the form carries school_id/date/enrolled/present fields; missing fields are recorded as errors and skipped. Runs only when LINDELA_LITE_KOBO_ENABLED=on with base_url, asset_uid and api_token.

input.field_mapping: object; a school_attendance entry maps canonical names to Kobo field names: { kind, school_id, date, enrolled, present, absent?, school_name?, district? }

description: Generic IoT sensor gateway pull: one GET returning a JSON array of readings (sensor_id, sensor_type, district, lat/lon, observed_at, value, unit, battery_pct). Each reading is normalized with the closed sensor-type enum and per-type unit defaults; a reading that fails validation lands in errors and the rest of the batch still returns. Runs only when LINDELA_LITE_IOT_ENABLED=on and request.base_url is set; the bearer token is sent only when configured.

input.base_url: string — gateway endpoint returning a JSON array of readings
